# CodeMonkey

> > Game-based coding education platform teaching kids programming through interactive courses in Python, CoffeeScript, and block-based coding.

CodeMonkey provides K-12 computer science curriculum with courses like Coding Adventure, Game Builder, Space Adventure, and CodeMonkey Jr. The platform serves teachers, schools, and students worldwide with activities for Hour of Code and Computer Science Education Week.

## Key Topics

- CoffeeScript
- Python
- Block-based coding
- Hour of Code
- Game-based learning
- Coding Adventure
- Game Builder
- CodeMonkey Jr.
- Computer Science Education Week
- K-12 education
- Teacher resources
- Space Adventure
- Banana Tales
- Dodo Does Math
- JavaScript

## For Teachers

- [Teaching Kids to Code | Game-Based Coding Curriculum | CodeMonkey](https://www.codemonkey.com/teachers): Game-based coding curriculum for teachers using Python and CoffeeScript

## Hour of Code Activities

- [Hour of Code | Free Coding Courses and Activities  | CodeMonkey](https://www.codemonkey.com/hour-of-code): Hour of Code activities with block-based, Python, and CoffeeScript courses

## Teacher Resources

- [Teacher Notes | CodeMonkey](https://www.codemonkey.com/hour-of-code/game-builder/teacher-notes): Game Builder teacher notes for Hour of Code platformer activities

## Regional Programs

- [קודמאנקי מלמדת תלמידים תכנות באמצעות משחק | CodeMonkey](https://www.codemonkey.com/israeli-schools-hebrew): Hebrew/Arabic CodeMonkey programming courses for Israeli schools
